# .inf, tags and non-string keys have a JSON stand-in a schema can check.
yamlschema -schema schema.json ok.yaml
! yamlschema -schema schema.json bad.yaml
stdout '^bad.yaml:1:'

-- schema.json --
{"type":"object","properties":{"limit":{"enum":["Infinity",5]},"blob":{"type":"string","contentEncoding":"base64"}},"propertyNames":{"pattern":"^[a-z0-9]+$"}}
-- ok.yaml --
limit: .inf
blob: !!binary aGVsbG8=
1: one
-- bad.yaml --
limit: .nan
